name: Bose-Josephson junction without interaction
question: How does the population imbalance of four atoms in two wells evolve under tunnelling and an energy offset?
assumptions: Closed unitary dynamics; hbar = 1; energies and rates in one arbitrary unit.
Two-mode approximation; no interaction between the atoms; the atom number is conserved.

provenance.reference: G. J. Milburn et al., Phys. Rev. A 55, 4318 (1997); J. Schwinger, boson representation of angular momentum (1952)
